description: Source code implementing Device Firmware Update (DFU) protocol handling for a bootloader, including functions for jumping to application, reading/writing flash, handling commands, and communication over a custom protocol.

methods.name: getMcuRevision
methods.description: Retrieves the MCU revision ID code.

methods.name: getByte
methods.description: Reads a byte from the communication channel with timeout.

methods.name: sendByte
methods.description: Sends a byte over the communication channel.

methods.name: isBootloaderAddress
methods.description: Checks if an address is within the bootloader flash region.

methods.name: isInVirtualPageBuffer
methods.description: Checks if an address is within the virtual page buffer.

methods.name: readAddress
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit address with checksum validation.

methods.name: complementByte
methods.description: Returns the bitwise complement of a byte.

methods.name: bufToInt16
methods.description: Converts a 2-byte buffer to a 16-bit integer.

methods.name: prepareInterruptsForJump
methods.description: Prepares interrupt vectors for jumping to application.

methods.name: dfuJumpToApp
methods.description: Jumps to application code at specified address.

methods.name: dfuHandleGetList
methods.description: Handles DFU command to get list of supported commands.

methods.name: dfuHandleDeviceId
methods.description: Handles DFU command to get device ID.

methods.name: dfuHandleGo
methods.description: Handles DFU command to jump to application at specified address.

methods.name: dfuHandleRead
methods.description: Handles DFU command to read data from flash or virtual buffer.

methods.name: dfuHandleWrite
methods.description: Handles DFU command to write data to flash or virtual buffer.

methods.name: dfuHandleErase
methods.description: Handles DFU command to erase sectors.

methods.name: dfuStartLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing incoming DFU commands.

methods.name: getTsChannel
methods.description: Returns pointer to the communication channel.
